title: Handling the maximum number of allowed active user-plane resources for PDU sessions of UEs in NB-N1 mode

entities.name: UE in NB-N1 mode
entities.description: UE operating in NB-N1 mode with specific limitations on user-plane resources.

entities.name: Maximum user-plane resources = 1
entities.description: Condition where UE supports only one active user-plane resource.

entities.name: Maximum user-plane resources = 2
entities.description: Condition where UE supports two active user-plane resources.

entities.name: PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure to release PDU session via explicit 5GSM signalling when maximum active user-plane resources are reached.

entities.name: Exception data reporting
entities.description: Special case where PDU session is used for exception data reporting and has protection from release under normal conditions.

entities.name: Upper layer request for user-plane resources
entities.description: Request from upper layers for additional user-plane resources when maximum is reached.

relations.description: UE in NB-N1 mode may have maximum user-plane resources limited to one.
UE in NB-N1 mode may have maximum user-plane resources limited to two if multiple user-plane resources supported.
Upper layer request triggers PDU session release procedure when maximum active resources are reached.
PDU session with exception data reporting shall not be released under normal conditions, but must be released if needed for exception data reporting request.
Upper layer request for exception data reporting forces release of another PDU session with user-plane resources.
